## Accepted partial result and exact limit

Add the complete report and independent mathematical audit for 30005477 / OWR-12697711-012. The status remains **UNRESOLVED, 1/5 substantive approaches used**.

The coordinate-row argument proves essential normality exactly when degreewise squared adjoint leakage tends to zero, an exact one-step coefficient inverse cost, and one fixed finite homogeneous family's finite-product decomposition bound. Essential normality gives a subexponential degree-dependent product-energy estimate. Summable leakage is an additional sufficient condition for a uniform stable-division constant; it is not derived from essential normality and is not necessary even for the principal radical ideal shown.

The prime infinite-codimensional example proves instability of a prescribed pair. One redundant generator repairs its entire displayed witness sequence. This is not an ideal-level counterexample; essential normality of that prime ideal and stability of the enlarged family on the whole ideal are not asserted. No full converse, new positive geometric subclass or novelty claim is granted.

## Attribution and complete retained mathematics

Shalit's [stable-division paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1003.0502v2) is credited for the definition, forward implication and prior generating-family warning. Kennedy's [decomposability paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1202.1797v2) is credited for the closed-sum characterization and corresponding example. Shamovich's [OWR contribution](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/47009), printed pp. 848–850, supplies the target and reports ongoing Kennedy–Shamovich angle work. Its radical/general homogeneous scope ambiguity is preserved.

The report is byte-identical to the independently reviewed original. The substantive source interpretation, all mathematical audit Sections 2–8 and the complete acceptance limits are retained verbatim. Only audit computational-reproduction material and out-of-edition administrative wording are removed or adapted. The scoped acceptance preserves the original mathematical verdict and binds the actual distributed editions. Public source PDF identities and retrieval/inspection history are retained without distributing source copies or extracted text.

AI-assisted and unrefereed. No external human peer review, proof-assistant certification, exhaustive present-day literature status or original-discovery claim is asserted.

## Repository boundary

Exactly eight files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005477/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated record, historical status or turn count changes. Edition preparation adds no proof-search turn and does not manufacture or reset accounting.

The packet contains authored proof, mathematical audit, scoped acceptance and public bibliographic verification metadata only. It excludes source bodies, datasets, private material, scripts, fixtures, standalone computation outputs and logs, and identities of excluded artifacts. No excluded artifact is transformed into replacement prose. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

Exact editorial differences and byte-preserved mathematical blocks were checked. Public source PDF byte/hash identities, UTF-8 and JSON, relative links, manifest, exact allowlist and excluded-material scan passed. The additive patch passed a strict-whitespace clean temporary replay with exact paths and bytes. The pinned base Git tree chain was freshly read and independently rehashed; unrelated entries, including the QUEUE blob, are preserved. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification; no CI pass is claimed. Exact-head remote readback remains a separate publication check.
